includes: Life jackets, sandals, ponchos, wool pull-over, boots (when cold)
blurb: Guests experience a 60-minute jet boat tour starting from the Old Port of Montreal, including 15 minutes to reach the rapids, 30 minutes in the rapids, and 15 minutes return. The tour offers views of Montreal landmarks such as Habitat 67, the Biosphere, and the Champlain Bridge. Gear including life jackets, sandals, ponchos, and lockers are provided; guests should bring a change of clothes.
